title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI systems. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge will directly shape how AI reasons about hardware, architecture, and systems.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to apply your expertise in a meaningful, flexible way — working remotely on cutting-edge AI problems at the frontier of computer engineering.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Challenges — Craft advanced computer engineering problems spanning RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware-software co-design to stress-test AI reasoning
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions — including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams — that serve as reference benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated code (C/C++, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify logical flaws such as race conditions, memory leaks, and timing constraint violations, and deliver structured feedback that improves how AI models think through problems

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related discipline
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low-level software logic clearly in writing
* Precise and detail-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and timing diagrams
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or AI benchmarking
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, SolidWorks, or ANSYS
* Familiarity with embedded systems toolchains or HDL simulation environments

**Why Join Us**

* Work on intellectually stimulating problems at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Collaborate with a global network of domain experts and leading AI researchers
* Freelance autonomy with the potential for ongoing contract extension
* Make a direct, lasting impact on how AI understands the physical and logical world of computing

* Attends meetings and co-ordinates with project design team (Developers, architects, main contractors, and structural and consulting engineers).

Technical support in the Sales / Tendering process:

* Accountable for solution engineering. Ensures that the proposed solution fulfils the codes, regulations, and safety requirements. Provides all in house engineering and technical advice across the product and process range.

Customer focused with excellent attention to detail

title: Research Mentor
description:
1.About Uppseekers

Uppseekers is a premium study abroad counseling company dedicated to helping studentsachieve their international education goals. We provide end-to-end guidance, from profilebuilding and university shortlisting to applications, scholarships, financial aid, and visa support.Our team of certified and experienced counselors delivers personalized, data-driven guidance to help students secure admission to leading universities worldwide and maximize their academic and scholarship opportunities.

2. Role Overview

Freelance Research Mentor

We are looking for passionate and experienced Research Mentor to join our growing team at Uppseekers.📍 Location: Remote💼

Type: Freelance💰

Compensation: To be finalized post discussion

The Research Mentor will be responsible for guiding students through the research paper development lifecycle, from understanding research fundamentals and refining a research question to reviewing completed papers and assisting with journal selection and submission.

The ideal candidate should be capable of simplifying research concepts for school students, providing structured academic guidance, and maintaining high standards of research quality, originality, and academic integrity.

3. Key Responsibilities

A. Research Teaching and Student Mentorship

Conduct structured online mentoring sessions for high school students in Grades 7–12.

Teach research fundamentals, including research question formulation, literature reviews, research methodology, data collection, analysis, interpretation, and academic writing.

Help students refine their research topics, objectives, hypotheses, and scope based on their interests and academic capabilities.

Guide students in identifying credible sources, understanding citations and referencing styles, and avoiding plagiarism.

Explain research concepts in a student-friendly manner and ensure students understand the work they produce.

Track student progress and provide actionable guidance throughout the research process.

B. Research Paper Review and Quality Improvement

Review completed research papers for structure, clarity, originality, methodology, data interpretation, referencing, and academic quality.

Provide detailed, constructive feedback and identify areas requiring revision.

Guide students through multiple rounds of revisions until the paper meets an appropriate submission standard.

Identify methodological weaknesses, unsupported conclusions, citation issues, and gaps in the literature review.

Ensure students retain authorship and ownership of their work, with all revisions reflecting genuine student understanding and contribution.

Maintain clear review records and communicate progress to the assigned program manager or counselling team.

C. Journal Shortlisting and Publication Assistance

Identify credible journals, student research journals, and other appropriate academic publication venues relevant to each paper's subject and quality.

Evaluate journals based on subject relevance, editorial standards, peer-review process, indexing where applicable, publication timelines, fees, eligibility criteria, and credibility.

Prepare a recommended journal shortlist with the rationale for each recommendation.

Explain submission requirements, formatting guidelines, author declarations, and documentation to students.

Assist students in preparing manuscripts for submission and navigating the submission process.

Guide students through editorial feedback, rejection, resubmission, and revisions when required.

Maintain realistic expectations regarding publication timelines and outcomes; never guarantee acceptance or publication.

D. Documentation and Coordination

Maintain student-wise records of mentoring sessions, research milestones, review comments, and pending tasks.

Submit progress updates and flag delays or academic concerns to the Program Manager.

Coordinate with counsellors and the research team to align research deliverables with each student's broader academic profile-building plan.

Ensure timely completion of assigned mentoring sessions, paper reviews, and publication-support deliverables.

Follow Uppseekers' internal processes for scheduling, reporting, and student communication.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed on the quality, timeliness, and effectiveness of mentoring rather than publication outcomes alone.

KPI

* 100% of assigned sessions conducted as scheduled, subject to approved rescheduling

* 100% of session notes and progress updates submitted within the prescribed timeline

* Initial review completed within 3–5 working days of receiving a complete manuscript, unless otherwise agreed

* Reviews provide specific, actionable feedback covering relevant academic and methodological issues

* Students receive structured guidance through the agreed revision cycles

* A relevant, evidence-based shortlist provided within 3–5 working days after the paper is ready for journal evaluation

* Submission requirements and next steps communicated clearly and promptly

* Progress against agreed research milestones is tracked and delays are escalated proactively

* Positive student feedback on clarity, responsiveness, and usefulness of mentorship

* No tolerance for plagiarism, fabricated data, manipulated results, or misleading publication claims

* Targets may be adjusted based on paper complexity, student readiness, mentor workload, and the agreed scope of engagement.

5. Requirements and Qualifications

* A PhD, with research experience in a any discpline.

* Prior experience in academic research, research writing, manuscript review, or research mentorship.

* Strong understanding of research methodology, academic writing, literature reviews, citations, and referencing.

* Ability to critically evaluate research papers and provide structured, constructive feedback.

* Familiarity with academic journals, submission processes, editorial review, and publication ethics.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to explain complex academic concepts in a simple and engaging way to high school students.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple students and deadlines remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

* A PhD, with research experience in a any discpline.

* Experience mentoring school students or undergraduate students on research projects.

* Experience publishing papers in credible, peer-reviewed journals.

* Familiarity with journal indexing, peer-review standards, publication fees, and predatory-journal identification.

* Experience assisting with manuscript revisions, journal rejections, resubmissions, and editorial correspondence.

* Familiarity with tools such as Google Scholar, Zotero, Mendeley, Google Docs, and plagiarism-screening tools.

6. Skills and Competencies

* Research expertise: Ability to assess the quality and feasibility of student research.

* Mentorship: Patient, structured, and encouraging approach to teaching young learners.

* Critical evaluation: Ability to identify weaknesses in methodology, argumentation, and evidence.

* Academic writing: Strong command of research structure, clarity, and referencing.

* Publication knowledge: Ability to distinguish credible publication venues from questionable ones.

* Communication: Clear written feedback and professional student interaction.

* Ownership: Consistent follow-through on assigned deliverables and deadlines.

* Ethical judgment: Commitment to originality, transparent authorship, and responsible research practices.

7. Expected Deliverables

For each assigned student, the Research Mentor may be responsible for:

* Conducting scheduled research mentoring sessions.

* Helping the student define and execute a feasible research project.

* Reviewing the completed manuscript and sharing consolidated feedback.

* Guiding the student through revisions and quality checks.

* Preparing a journal shortlist with supporting information and recommendations.

* Assisting with manuscript formatting and the submission process.

* Tracking submission status and advising on editorial feedback or resubmission, as included in the agreed scope.

* Submitting session records and progress reports to Uppseekers.

* The number of sessions, review rounds, and publication-support requirements will be defined for each student assignment.

8. Working Arrangement

* Remote, online mentoring.

* Flexible scheduling based on student availability and mentor commitments.

* Engagement may be part-time, freelance, or contractual.

* Compensation will be based on the agreed engagement model, session requirements, and scope of work.

* Timely communication and adherence to assigned student milestones are essential.

9. Success in This Role

* A successful Research Mentor will help students become more capable, independent researchers; improve the quality and credibility of their manuscripts; and make informed decisions about suitable publication opportunities. The goal is to deliver a rigorous, ethical, and well-supported research experience that strengthens each student's academic development.

To Apply: Share your updated CV over at raj.bane@uppseekers.com with the subject line "Research Mentor Application".

title: Assistant Consultant - Project Management

* Capable of managing, recording, and prioritizing business activities, with the ability to recognize and reconcile conflicts to achieve objectives.
* Responsive to change, with the ability to accurately record and communicate variations and their consequences.

Technical & Professional Skills

BGV:

title: Senior Content Writer-B2B
description:
About All In Motion

All In Motion is a global B2B creative agency. We partner with enterprise organisations to turn complex brand challenges into creative assets that support growth.

The role

As Senior Content Writer, you own the words behind our clients' enterprise campaigns, from first brief to published asset. You turn complex subjects into clear, credible content for business buyers, in each client's voice, across video, long-form and social.

Success means content that is accurate, on-brand, on time and tied to the client's commercial goal.

What you will do

•     Turn client briefs into content plans and copy that serve the client's business goal, audience and stage of the buying journey.

•     Write scripts for corporate videos, brand films, advertisements and explainers that deliver the client's message within agreed deadlines.

•     Produce thought leadership, whitepapers, technical documents, case studies and blogs that are accurate and meet industry standards, interviewing subject-matter experts to get the detail right.

•     Working knowledge of SEO keyword optimisation and ranking, and experience in YouTube strategy and content creation.

•     The confidence to lead brainstorms, manage several projects at once and meet deadlines.

•     Ease working with clients and stakeholders across time zones.

Qualifications and experience

•     Experience: 5 or more years in B2B content, media or a related field.

•     Location: Mumbai, India.

title: Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services
description:
At Corbion, we exist to champion preservation in all its forms, preserving food and food production, health, and our planet.

**The role**

As Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services, you will connect customer needs with practical ingredient solutions that support product innovation and commercial growth across India. Your primary focus will be bakery applications, complemented by opportunities in confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood.

This is a senior, customer-facing technical role rather than a traditional laboratory-based R&D position. You will engage directly with customers and their R&D teams, explore their current and future technical challenges, and translate these insights into viable solutions. Working closely with Corbion’s product management, commercial, regional and global application teams, you will develop, test and implement solutions using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.

A unique part of the position is the opportunity to help establish Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai. You will contribute your expertise and recommendations during its development and subsequently lead its activities as a regional innovation hub. The laboratory will support bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments applications and enable customer solutions to be tested and optimized before implementation at customer locations.

The position is based fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and involves approximately 30% to 40% travel, primarily within India and, where required, selected South Asian markets. Customer implementation and plant trials may require visits of several consecutive days.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build trusted technical partnerships with customers, distributors and strategic accounts by understanding their product, process, quality and manufacturing challenges.
* Work directly with customer R&D teams to identify current and future application needs and translate these into commercially viable ingredient solutions.
* Develop and optimize applications using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.
* Lead formulation and application work across bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood, with bakery as the primary area of focus.
* Develop solutions addressing shelf-life extension, food safety, clean-label reformulation, texture enhancement, yield improvement, flavour optimization and cost-in-use reduction.
* Take customer development projects from initial needs assessment and laboratory trials through validation, implementation and commercialization.
* Design and conduct application trials, including ingredient selection, dosage optimization and process improvement, to identify solutions customers can efficiently validate and implement.
* Lead customer plant trials, industrial validation and implementation across multiple manufacturing locations where required.
* Troubleshoot formulation, preservation, processing and implementation challenges, and conduct product benchmarking and competitive evaluations.
* Work with regional and global product management and application teams to adapt existing knowledge and solutions to Indian market requirements.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to establishing Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai, and lead it as a center of excellence supporting customer innovation and business growth.
* Define laboratory objectives, budgets, equipment investment plans and capability-development roadmaps; manage resources, maintenance, calibration, utilization and materials inventory.
* Coordinate pilot-scale and customer-simulation trials, introduce new testing methodologies, and maintain protocols, formulation databases, technical reports and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Corbion’s safety, quality, food-safety and housekeeping standards and support internal and external laboratory audits.
* Deliver technical presentations, customer workshops, seminars and training programs, and support customer qualification processes and technical audits.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities, develop the commercial pipeline and convert technical projects into business growth.
* Participate in strategic customer engagements, business reviews, innovation sessions, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry forums.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging technologies, and recommend innovation priorities based on customer and market insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and regional and global R&D teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and, as the laboratory develops, help build and coach its technical capabilities.

**You bring**

*Requirements*

* A bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a closely related food-science discipline.
* At least 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in food ingredients, food manufacturing or the specialty ingredients industry.
* Strong experience in customer-facing technical support and the credibility to work directly with experienced customer R&D and manufacturing teams.
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients and their functionality within finished-product applications, with strong technical expertise in bakery applications.
* Experience in at least one additional relevant category, preferably confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry or seafood. Deep bakery expertise with some confectionery exposure may also fit.
* The ability to explore customer needs in depth, ask strong technical questions and translate customer challenges into practical application and ingredient solutions.
* Experience with laboratory or application trials, formulation optimization, technical troubleshooting and implementation in customer production environments.
* Understanding of product scale-up and commercialization, including implementation across multiple customer manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of food preservation, clean-label product development, food safety and microbiology fundamentals.
* Strong project leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
* A customer-focused, commercially aware and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across functions and geographies.
* Willingness to work fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and travel approximately 30% to 40%.

*Preferred*

* A master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a related discipline.
* Experience in application or product development. Candidates whose primary strength is customer-facing technical support may also fit when combined with strong ingredient knowledge and solution-development capability.
* Experience leading or contributing to the establishment, management or capability development of an application laboratory.
* Experience within a multinational food-ingredient company.
* Specialized training or experience in bakery, confectionery, meat processing, culinary products, preservation technologies or product development.
* Knowledge of organic acids, cultured ingredients, fermentation-based solutions, functional blends and emulsifiers.
* Knowledge of HACCP, GMP, FSSC 22000 and other relevant food-quality systems.
* Experience with experimental design, laboratory documentation, audits and equipment or budget planning.
* Previous production experience or direct exposure to customer manufacturing environments.
* Experience coaching or developing technical or laboratory colleagues.

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to shape and lead Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai and contribute your expertise while its capabilities are being established.
* A highly visible role combining customer engagement, technical problem-solving, application development and commercial impact.
* The opportunity to work on strategic innovation priorities, including natural preservation solutions for bakery and new confectionery applications.
* Direct collaboration with customer R&D and manufacturing teams and with Corbion’s Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing and global innovation organizations.
* Access to expertise from Corbion’s regional and global application teams, allowing successful technologies and solutions from other markets to be adapted for India.
* The opportunity to build application capabilities that strengthen Corbion’s position as an innovation partner for preservation, food safety, clean-label and sustainable ingredient solutions.
* Scope to build and develop a technical laboratory team as the Navi Mumbai facility grows.
* Potential to broaden into larger technical-commercial or business-development responsibilities in India and across Asia.
* The opportunity to contribute to measurable customer and business outcomes, including successful product launches, commercialized projects, improved technical solutions and stronger strategic partnerships.

Black & Veatch allows you to lend your talent and perspective to humanity’s biggest challenges in a flexible environment where you are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities.
  
  
Our hybrid environment allows you to balance your work and personal life. At Black & Veatch, you own your career with purpose and meaning. You are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities at every step of your career journey. Bring your big ideas while knowing you are safe to be who you are and speak up with concerns or questions and put your diverse talents and perspectives to use.
  
  
Black & Veatch is seeking an exceptional and experienced professional to join our Infrastructure Advisory organization as a Manager – Consulting to provide expertise around OT Systems implementation and other related utility OT projects in an Integration Architecture capacity. The world is changing at an unprecedented rate and that change increases the demand for innovation and efficiency to deliver solutions and services across the world’s utility infrastructure. Join Black & Veatch’s growing Infrastructure Advisory business and use your talents and expertise to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our clients, with the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your professional network, and shape a rewarding career path aligned with your aspirations.
  
  
The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early-to-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. Peers are engaged in a wide range of technical projects and encouraged to sharpen their skills to provide clients superior consulting services and continue to advance in a specialized career track. You will work with professionals in the Consulting and Digital Delivery Teams who represent a dynamic and cross-functional group of experts in strategy, data, technology, and asset management systems. Together, they deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that help clients navigate complex infrastructure challenges across diverse industries.
  
  
We partner with clients to align their people, processes, technologies, and data in response to rapid industry transformation. Our work enables organizations to modernize infrastructure, optimize asset performance, enhance resilience, and achieve long-term sustainability goals. By joining this team, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and client success. You’ll contribute to mission-critical projects that make a meaningful impact on communities and industries around the world.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The Solution Integrator is responsible for designing, orchestrating, and validating complex technology solutions across operational technology (OT) and enterprise IT environments. This role ensures that systems such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, and associated platforms function cohesively as an integrated operational ecosystem. The Solution Integrator provides technical leadership across solution architecture, integration design, cybersecurity alignment, and end-to-end system validation within large-scale utility transformation programs.
  
  

* Solution Architecture & Design
* Develop and document end-to-end solution architecture across OT and IT systems, including ADMS, EMS, SCADA, GIS, and enterprise platforms
* Define logical and technical architectures, including system boundaries, data flows, and interface patterns
* Lead architecture workshops and design sessions to align stakeholders on solution approach
* System Integration Design & Oversight
* Design and oversee integration architecture across multiple systems, vendors, and technologies
* Define integration patterns, interface specifications, and data exchange requirements across IT/OT boundaries
* Ensure interoperability and end-to-end functionality across integrated workflows
* IT/OT Integration & Operational Alignment
* Lead the design and implementation of IT/OT integration strategies, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and control system requirements
* Coordinate across OT systems (ADMS, EMS, DERMS, SCADA) and enterprise IT systems (CIS, ERP, GIS)
* Ensure solutions support real-time operations, reliability, and operational decision-making
* Cybersecurity & Compliance Alignment
* Integrate cybersecurity principles into solution and integration design, including access control, data protection, and secure communication patterns
* Align system architecture with enterprise cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards
* Support risk identification, mitigation, and validation activities for OT and IT environments
* System Validation, Testing & Readiness Support
* Support end-to-end system validation by ensuring integration design aligns with test scenarios and operational requirements
* Collaborate with testing teams to validate system behavior, data flows, and integration performance
* Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of integration-related issues
* Integration Governance & Vendor Coordination
* Provide technical oversight and governance across vendors, internal teams, and system implementers
* Lead integration design reviews, ensure adherence to architecture standards, and manage technical risks
* Serve as the technical point of integration accountability across the project lifecycle

**Key Competencies**

* Systems thinking with the ability to connect complex technical components into a cohesive solution
* Strong stakeholder communication and facilitation across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive alignment across multiple vendors and workstreams
* Risk-aware mindset with focus on reliability, security, and operational performance

**Management Responsibilities**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in instrumentation, Information Technology or Engineering
* 10 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* 2+ years of experience with electric utility control systems operations or maintenance
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects through the complete lifecycle including requirements development, design, systems integration & implementation and testing
* Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC, IEEE) and utility regulatory environments
* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) and enterprise architecture frameworks
* Background in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related technical discipline
* Knowledge of or direct experience with Grid Management & Modernization Solutions Deployment (e.g. Grid Modernization Technologies, Advanced Distribution Management System, Distributed Energy Resource Management System, Automated Metering Infrastructure) and/or Utility IT Transformation (Enterprise Asset Management, Work Management, Customer Information Systems, ERP)

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, instrumentation or computer engineering, Information Systems, or similar Technical domain
* 7 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* Extensive Knowledge of Electric utilities operations functions and associated processes
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects with technical domain experience
* Hands-on experience in utility OT platforms such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, DERMS, or related systems
* Deep understanding of system integration concepts including APIs, middleware, data models, and real-time data exchange
* Proven experience designing IT/OT integration architectures in complex, multi-vendor environments
* Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for critical infrastructure systems (e.g., identity management, network segmentation, secure integration patterns)
* Experience working across full system lifecycle including design, integration, testing, and go-live
* Familiarity with major industry trends and OT/ADMS/DERMS vendor solutions

**Certifications**

title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof-of-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years overall experience including 3+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre-sales and solution consulting customer-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

****Nice to Have****

* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer-facing engagements from preparation through follow-up.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

title: Senior Manager/ Manager - Process Excellence
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear: to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what's next. If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.

**About the Role**

**This isn't a typical process or operations role.**

You will build and own the Process Excellence function within CoinDCX's Customer Experience organisation: the discipline that decides why CX processes break and how they get fixed for good, not just how a single ticket gets resolved. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of process governance, root cause analysis, and regulatory risk, directly shaping how millions of Indian customers experience crypto. You'll define the standards the frontline operates against, run the root cause discipline that turns escalation patterns into structural fixes, and hold a formal line into Risk and Compliance, making this one of the most foundational roles in our Customer Experience function.

**What You'll Do**

**Process Governance & SOP Ownership**

* Own the single source of truth for CX SOPs and playbooks, including version control and audit trails.
* Run staleness audits to ensure SOPs are updated within a defined window of any related policy or product change.
* Chair the Process Governance Forum with Product, Ops, Tech, and QA to review and approve process changes before rollout.

**Root Cause Analysis & Structural Fixes**

* Analyse escalation, repeat contact, and complaint data to identify root causes, using structured problem-solving methods such as DMAIC, 5 Whys, or fishbone analysis.
* Convert findings into structural fixes and route them to the correct owner in Product, Ops, or Policy, tracking each one through to closure.
* Own RCA cycle time as a core performance metric, and drive down repeat contacts tied to process, not agent, causes.

**Process Mapping, Value Stream Analysis & Automation**

* Map and continuously refine CX process flows end to end, identifying redundant handoffs, manual steps, and friction points.
* Identify and prioritise automation opportunities, building the business case in partnership with Tech and Engineering, who own build and deployment.

**Risk & Compliance Process Governance**

* Run a standing monthly review with Risk and Compliance on process gaps carrying fraud, AML/KYC, or regulatory exposure.
* Ensure no process change affecting a Risk or Compliance-tagged workflow goes live without sign-off from that review.

**Data Analysis & Insights**

* Perform deep-dive analysis on escalation trends, complaint drivers, SOP staleness, and automation ROI.
* Build and maintain a KPI tree covering SOP coverage, RCA cycle time, escalation reduction, and automation throughput.
* Translate insights into a prioritised, quantified roadmap rather than a running list of observations.

**Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership**

* Collaborate closely with QA, Ops, WFM, Product, Tech, and Risk & Compliance to keep process ownership clean and non-overlapping.
* Lead adoption tracking, training handoff, and post-launch adherence checks for every process rollout, since a change that isn't adopted isn't a fix.
* Act as the bridge between what leadership expects and what actually happens on the ground, and be direct when the two don't match.

**You'll Excel in This Role If You**

* Think in root causes, not symptoms, and build systems to prevent problems rather than waiting for them to escalate.
* Are obsessed with data and evidence, and use it to decide what to fix first, not instinct alone.
* Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to processes that today only live in people's heads.
* Communicate with precision, equally credible in a Risk and Compliance review and a frontline training session.
* Have a strong bias for action and a track record of shipping fixes, not just documenting problems.
* Can balance systems thinking (governance, frameworks, standards) with hands-on execution (process maps, SOP rewrites, RCA deep dives).
* Are comfortable being the person who challenges the status quo across teams that don't report to you.

**You'll Know You're Winning When**

**Key Success Metrics for the First 6 Months**

* A full SOP inventory is live with staleness flags, and the highest-priority SOPs are updated and version-controlled.
* The top 10 escalation themes by volume and cost are diagnosed with root causes identified, and at least two to three structural fixes are shipped.
* The Process Governance Forum and the Risk & Compliance Joint Review are stood up and running on a defined cadence.
* A live, prioritised automation opportunity pipeline exists with quantified impact.
* You've built trust-based working relationships with QA, Ops, Product, Tech, and Risk & Compliance leadership.

**Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You**

Process is the backbone of trust at CoinDCX. In a high-stakes, regulated, and fast-moving industry like crypto, a process that breaks isn't just a customer experience problem, it's a fraud vector or a compliance finding waiting to happen. This role gives you the mandate to build that backbone from the ground up, with direct visibility into leadership decisions, a formal seat in Risk and Compliance conversations, and the rare opportunity to design how CX processes work as CoinDCX scales, rather than inheriting someone else's system.

**What You'll Need**

* 6 to 8 years of experience in process excellence, continuous improvement, or operational excellence, preferably within customer experience, contact centre, or BPO environments.
* Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or DMAIC.
* Demonstrated track record of owning SOP or knowledge base governance and running root-cause-to-fix cycles, not just producing analysis.
* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, or dashboards to interpret complex data.
* Experience building process flow diagrams using tools such as LucidChart, Miro, or Visio.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional change and secure process adoption from teams that do not report into this role.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior leadership, Risk, and Compliance.
* Working familiarity with CRMs like Sprinklr, FreshDesk, ZenDesk, or similar platforms.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in fintech, crypto, or high-growth startups.
* Prior exposure to AML, KYC, or fraud risk processes in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of automation, workflows, or RPA-driven process redesign.
* Exposure to tools like SQL, Power BI, or other data visualisation platforms.

**Hiring Process**

Here's what your journey with us looks like:

* Application Review: We assess for skills, process depth, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect: A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s): Deep dive into your approach to process governance, root cause analysis, and stakeholder management [2 rounds]
* Culture & Values Discussion: A conversation about our ways of working and how you thrive best.

**Where We Work**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, with occasional travel for process audits where required.

**Perks That Empower You**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities.

**Ready to Build What's Next?**

If you're looking for a role that gives you the mandate to build a function from scratch, direct ownership of how CoinDCX's CX processes hold up at scale, and a seat in the room where Risk, Product, and Leadership make decisions, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

description:
**Biochemistry Subject Matter Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more scientifically rigorous AI models — and we need expert biochemists to make it happen. Your deep knowledge of molecular biology, enzyme kinetics, and metabolic systems will directly shape how AI reasons through complex life science problems.

* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote setting
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational biochemistry tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, curriculum development, or technical communication


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Gain firsthand exposure to how advanced large language models (LLMs) are trained and evaluated
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global network of domain experts

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**

That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.

* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, demonstrating leadership, ownership, and accountability.
* Willing and able to travel as required by the role.


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

**Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**
**What You Will Be Accountable For**
* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, define, document, clarify, and validate business and operational requirements.
* Ensure new processes, system functionality, and implementations align with established business requirements and operational needs.
* Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test execution, business process validation, issue identification, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Validate system functionality, workflows, and business processes prior to deployment.
* Review and validate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure processes are accurate, practical, and aligned with business requirements.
* Identify gaps, defects, process issues, or operational risks uncovered during testing and implementation and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.
* Support store and end\-user readiness for implementation and go\-live.
* Develop and/or support training materials, process documentation, job aids, and other resources associated with the new program.
* Facilitate or support end\-user and service\-related training to drive understanding and successful adoption of new processes.
* Support implementation and training activities associated with facilities and work\-order management processes.
* Coordinate with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, store stakeholders, and other program resources throughout the rollout.
* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.


**What Qualifications You Need**
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst experience, including business analysis, program/project implementation, business operations, or a related area.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Hands\-on experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and/or business process testing.
* Experience gathering, documenting, clarifying, and validating business requirements.
* Experience supporting implementation projects and validating that solutions meet established business and operational requirements.
* Experience identifying issues during testing or implementation and coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders through resolution.
* Exposure to SOP/process validation, operational readiness, training, or go\-live activities strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify process gaps, risks, and inconsistencies.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines, and stakeholders within a fast\-paced implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, facilities, and operational teams.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly engaged with a cross\-functional project team.
* Ability to maintain a strong focus on both implementation timelines and quality within a highly visible program.
* Must be available to work primarily during 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST business hours, with some flexibility to start approximately one hour earlier or later.
* Ability and willingness to travel to Deerfield, IL up to approximately three times during the nine\-month engagement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting retail, retail facilities, store operations, refrigeration, facilities operations, or other multi\-site environments.
* Experience supporting large\-scale program implementations or enterprise rollouts across multiple locations.
* Experience working with facilities or work\-order management processes and platforms.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for project, testing, issue, or implementation tracking.
* Exposure to ServiceChannel or similar facilities/work\-order management systems.
* Experience with data collection tools or platforms used to support implementation and validation activities.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, review, validate, and analyze implementation or operational data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with external vendors and cross\-functional implementation teams.
* Exposure to sensor\-based monitoring, automated workflows, refrigeration/HVAC, facilities technology, or similar operational technology environments is a plus but not required.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Senior Manager, EMEA Equity Documentation Negotiator (Mumbai)
description:
EMEA Equity Documentation( ISDA) , Institutional Equity Division
   

  

 This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the EMEA Equity Documentation Group based in London. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.
   

  

 The current opening is for a professional within the EMEA team, based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the EMEA region.
   

  

**Global Capital Markets:** 
 In the Global Capital Markets division, we offer Global expertise in market analysis and in advisory and capital\-raising services for corporations, institutions, and governments
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team
* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.
* Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.
* Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.
* Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
* Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.
* Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.
* Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the Asia Pacific region.
* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Law graduate with relevant 8\-11 years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred. Legal qualification is advantageous.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.
* In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.
* Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.
* Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.
* Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.
* Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.
* Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.
* Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.
