title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers

**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to make AI smarter — and we need electrical engineers to help get there. **Why Join Us**
* Work on genuinely cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload
* Freelance autonomy with the backing of a professional, global team
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced large language models are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Associate
description:
**About Us** 




 The Spine Foundation is a non\-profit organization dedicated to delivering free, high\-quality spine care to underprivileged communities in rural India. Founded over 25 years ago by a team of committed spine surgeons, the foundation focuses on alleviating chronic pain, limited mobility, and loss of livelihood caused by spinal disorders. Through specialized camps and outreach programs, it provides essential diagnostics, surgeries, and rehabilitation to individuals who otherwise could not afford such care. A volunteer network of leading Indian spine surgeons ensures patients receive expert treatment and a real chance to regain independence. In addition to clinical services, the foundation actively promotes spinal health awareness and preventive education to enable long\-term community well\-being.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Spine Foundation is looking for a highly committed and mature professional to work closely with Dr. Shekar Bhojraj and shadow him across his institutional, clinical, field, donor, partner and stakeholder engagements.
 



 This is a senior coordination and documentation role designed to support continuity, capture institutional knowledge, strengthen follow\-up systems and enable more structured planning around Dr. Bhojraj’s work. The role is not a conventional Executive Assistant or Research Associate position. It requires someone who can understand the purpose of TSF’s work, observe closely, document meaningfully, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and support the translation of conversations into clear action points.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Shadowing Dr. Bhojraj’s Work** 




 Accompany or closely support Dr. Bhojraj across meetings, visits, discussions, field engagements, hospital and doctor interactions, partner meetings and other institutional activities. The person will be expected to understand the context, capture key points and ensure that important conversations are not lost.
 



**2\. Documentation of Conversations and Engagements** 




 Prepare concise and useful notes from meetings, field visits, calls and stakeholder interactions. This will include recording key decisions, commitments, follow\-up points, relationship context and any strategic issues that require attention.
 



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 




 Liaise regularly with doctors, hospitals, field teams, partners, donors, advisors, board members, consultants and other stakeholders connected with TSF’s work. The person should be able to communicate professionally, follow up respectfully and ensure that coordination does not remain dependent only on Dr. Bhojraj.
 



**4\. Planning, Scheduling and Follow\-up** 




 Support planning and scheduling of Dr. Bhojraj’s meetings, visits and travel\-linked engagements. This includes coordinating with relevant people, preparing briefs before meetings, ensuring that background information is available, and tracking follow\-up after each engagement.
 



**5\. Institutional Memory and Continuity** 




 Help TSF build stronger institutional memory around Dr. Bhojraj’s relationships, decisions, field insights and strategic directions. The person should be able to organise information in a way that helps the wider team, leadership and advisors take work forward with clarity.
 



**6\. Support to Strategic and Operational Priorities** 




 Work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and other identified team members or consultants to support planning around institutional priorities, donor conversations, centre\-level engagements, doctor networks, camps, outreach visits and emerging opportunities.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should have:
 



 • A Master’s degree in social work, public health, development studies, management, hospital administration, rural development or a related field.
 



 • 5\-8 years of relevant experience, preferably with exposure to both grassroots work and management\-level coordination.
 



 • Prior experience working closely with senior leadership, founders, trustees, doctors, programme heads or institutional leaders.
 



 • Strong understanding of community\-based work, health systems, rural development or social sector institutions.
 



 • Excellent documentation, note\-taking and synthesis skills.
 



 • Ability to capture not just minutes of meetings, but the larger context, relationships, concerns and follow\-up actions.
 



 • Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Ability to manage sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion.
 



 • Comfort with travel and accompanying leadership for field visits, stakeholder meetings and institutional engagements.
 



 • Good written and spoken communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of Marathi or other regional languages will be an added advantage.
 



 • High level of integrity, patience, humility and commitment to the cause of equitable spine care.
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The person must be deeply aligned with TSF’s mission and should be comfortable working in a role that requires observation, listening, coordination and quiet leadership. They should be proactive without being intrusive, organised without being bureaucratic, and sensitive to the clinical, human and institutional dimensions of Dr. Bhojraj’s work.
 



 This role is suitable for someone who is passionate about public health and social impact, and who sees value in helping an institution strengthen continuity around a founder’s vision, relationships and way of working.
 



 Reporting and Working Relationship
 



 The person will work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and coordinate with identified members of the TSF team, doctors, external advisors and consultants as required. The role will require regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders and will involve both office\-based and travel\-linked responsibilities.
 



 Expected Outcome of the Role
 


* Over time, the role should help TSF ensure that Dr. Bhojraj’s work, relationships, insights and decisions are better captured, followed through and institutionalized. The position is intended to strengthen continuity, coordination and leadership support as TSF prepares for its next phase of growth and sustainability.



  





**Salary/Compensation** 




 Will commensurate based on the experience
 



  





**Additional Information:** 
 This role requires frequent travel, field visits, and close accompaniment of senior leadership, often involving long and unpredictable working hours. Considering these operational requirements, preference may be given to male candidates.

 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant**

* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Associate Consultant - Business Consulting Risk - TMT - CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Mumbai
description:
Requisition Id: 1745550
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Associate Consultant\-TMT\-Business Consulting Risk\-CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls \- Mumbai
   

  

**TMT :**
 Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media \& Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
   

  

**CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Strong understanding of digital media business models and risk\-related process and control frameworks. Proficient in using MS Office tools to analyze, organize, and present business and risk data effectively. Ability to support process and controls assessments, identifying gaps and documenting control weaknesses. Exposure to internal audit concepts with the capability to contribute to audit planning, testing, and reporting activities. Working knowledge of PowerBI for data visualization and preparation of concise, insight\-driven management outputs.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Bachelor of Business Administration
* Certificate in Digital Marketing
* Certification in Data Analytics


**Experience**
* Data Analysis (2\+ years)
* Business Analysis (3\+ years)
* Technical Support (2\+ years)
* Digital Marketing (2\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

description:

* Excellent responsiveness, reliability, and communication skills.



  





**Essential Skills** 



* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Creative mindset for visual storytelling in academic contexts.
* Professionalism in team interactions and feedback incorporation (as and when needed).

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Bid Specialist

description:
**Company Description** 
 The company is a leading manufacturer of gas and liquid analyzers for process, combustion, emission, and renewable energy applications. Bhoomi has strong technical expertise in advanced technologies such as NDIR, UV\-DOAS, TDLAS, and FTIR, serving sectors including power plants, oil and refineries, pharmaceuticals, project engineering, and research institutes.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Bid Specialist role based in
 **Mulund.** 
 The Bid Specialist will oversee the end\-to\-end bid lifecycle, including planning, coordinating, and submitting competitive bids and proposals for gas and liquid analyzer projects and related solutions. Responsibilities include analyzing tender documents, defining bid strategies, preparing compliant and compelling technical and commercial responses, and collaborating with sales, engineering, and finance teams to gather required inputs. The role also involves maintaining standardized bid processes, tracking bid progress and outcomes, ensuring timely submission, and continuously improving templates and documentation. The Bid Manager will support post\-bid clarifications, participate in negotiations when required, and contribute to forecasting and pipeline management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Manage complete tender lifecycle on the GeM portal (bid participation to order execution)
* Identify relevant tenders, evaluate eligibility, and prepare bid submissions
* Handle technical and commercial documentation for tenders
* Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product specifications, and compliance
* Monitor bid status, follow\-ups, and ensure timely responses
* Maintain records of submitted tenders, approvals, and documentation
* Ensure compliance with government procurement norms and policies
* Track order processing, invoicing, and payment follow\-ups through GeM
* Stay updated with changes in GeM policies and procedures



  





**Key Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (preferred: Engineering/Management)
* 2–6 years of experience in GeM tender handling or government tendering
* Strong knowledge of GeM portal operations
* Familiarity with MS Excel, Word, and documentation processes
* Good understanding of technical specifications (preferred for engineering products)
* Excellent communication and coordination skills
* High attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in e\-procurement platforms apart from GeM
* Knowledge of government tendering norms
* Analytical and negotiation skills



  





**Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated expertise in bid\-focused activities such as Bid Preparation and Bid Writing, with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and persuasive documentation.
* Experience in Bid Management and Proposal Management, including coordinating cross\-functional inputs and managing multiple bids within defined timelines.
* Strong understanding of Bid Processes, with capability to implement and refine structured workflows, checklists, and compliance reviews.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field; experience in process industries or analytical instrumentation is an advantage.
* Proficient in MS Office (especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfortable working with tender portals and documentation systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and ability to analyze technical and commercial requirements.
* Proven organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet strict deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative working style, with the ability to engage effectively with sales, technical, and management teams on\-site in Mulund.

title: Associate Training Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Title:** 
 Training Architect
   

  

**Department/Function:** 
 Customer Experience
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 The Training Architect is responsible for designing and optimizing training processes, ensuring standardization, efficiency, and alignment with business goals. This role focuses on streamlining training operations, enhancing content delivery workflows, and leveraging technology to improve turnaround times and training impact.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Training Process Standardization \& Optimization
* Develop and implement standardized training workflows to ensure consistency across geographies and business units.
* Establish clear guidelines, checklists, and best practices for training execution, ensuring minimal friction between content creation, approval, and deployment.
* Reduce training development cycle times by 30\-40% through efficient process redesign, automation, and better cross\-team collaboration.
* Implement a structured training request intake and prioritization system to align training efforts with business needs and urgency.
* Technology Enablement \& Automation
* Evaluate, implement, and manage LMS, LCMS, AI\-powered tools, automation frameworks, and content delivery platforms to improve training efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks in the content development\-to\-deployment pipeline and introduce automation for faster review and approvals.
* Ensure seamless integration of training platforms with HR systems, CRM, knowledge management tools, and other business systems.
* Drive adoption of AI\-based content tagging, auto\-translation, and metadata standardization for faster content retrieval and reusability.
* Collaboration with Content Teams for Faster Turnaround
* Partner with Instructional Designers, SMEs, and content teams to identify process inefficiencies and implement structured workflows that improve productivity.
* Establish clear SLAs (Service Level Agreements) for content development, review, and publishing, ensuring a 25\-30% reduction in time\-to\-market for training content.
* Develop a feedback loop to capture content team challenges and continuously refine processes for smoother execution.
* Multi\-Portal Content Distribution \& Compliance
* Streamline content deployment across multiple LMSs, internal knowledge bases, customer\-facing portals, and third\-party platforms.
* Implement one\-click content publishing mechanisms that eliminate manual efforts and reduce content upload time by 40%.
* Ensure all training content complies with regulatory, industry, and internal branding standards.
* Data\-Driven Training Performance Measurement
* Define and track KPIs like training completion rates, knowledge retention scores, engagement analytics, and training impact on performance.
* Leverage data dashboards and predictive analytics to optimize training programs based on learner behavior and feedback.
* Conduct regular post\-training impact assessments to measure effectiveness and identify areas for process improvement.
* Continuous Improvement \& Scalability
* Drive quarterly process audits to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Develop a scalable training architecture that can support rapid business growth, global expansion, and evolving skill requirements.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and introduce best\-in\-class training methodologies, AI\-driven learning models, and workflow automation.

 Graduation: Bachelor of Commerce (B.com) / Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Arts (BA) / Bachelor of Business \& Insurance (BBI) / Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS)
   

  

 Post\-Graduation: Master of Business Administration (MBA) / Master of Commerce (M.com) / Master of Arts (MA)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5 \- 10 years of relevant experience

title: Supervisory Analyst
description:
**About BNP Paribas Group:** 




 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
 



  





**About Business line/Function:** 




 BNP Paribas Exane has three business lines: Cash Equities (BNP Paribas Exane); Structured Solutions (Exane Solutions); and Asset Management (Exane Asset Management). BNP Paribas Exane Equity Research, a part of the Cash equities business, provides equity research to Institutional investors globally. It currently has 106 equity research analysts covering more than 1,000 stocks globally.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Securities Research Production Support
 



  





**Business Line / Function:** 
 Equity Research
 



  





**Position Purpose** 




 The Supervisory Analyst (SA) reviews equity research reports written by a global team. The SA function is critical to ensure delivery of high\-quality publications with accurate, engaging and clear content conforming to relevant regulatory standards.
 



 The role will be based out of Mumbai and allows 50% WFH.
 








**Responsibilities** 




**Direct Responsibilities**



* Review analysts' financial models to ensure the meet internal quality standards
* Review equity research reports for grammar, style, clarity and accuracy. Where necessary, rewriting content to ensure that the reports have the right logical flow and to maximize market impact by providing catchy titles and engaging standfirsts.
* Ensure that research reports conform to regulatory, especially FINRA regulations regarding equity research reports, as well has internal standards.
* Managing consistency of content and style within and between documents.
* Correct discrepancies in text and tables/graphs.
* Ensure all internal processes are followed in publishing research reports.
* Ensure that reports do not have controversial, inaccurate, or disrespectful content.
* Participate in sounding boards to provide inputs to analysts to improve research report quality.



**Contributing Responsibilities**




 · Contribute to enhance the research quality and the research production process.
 





**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**



* Intellectual curiosity and interest in financial markets.
* Excellent command over English language.
* Excellent report writing and editing skills.
* Attention to detail – should be able to spot discrepancies between text and tables/graphs, and discern nuances in language.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills. Experience in financial modelling. Previous experience as an equity research analyst is also a big plus.
* Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity markets in particular, with a good knowledge of equity valuation methods like DCF analysis, comparison of valuation multiples, etc.
* Excellent interpersonal skills as the role involves continuous collaboration with research analysts and research management.
* Tact, judgement and diplomacy; respect for confidentiality.



  





**Education Level:** 
 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
 



  





**Experience Level:** 
 At least 11 years

title: Senior Document Controller
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Document Control lead on a project. Act as main interface between project personnel and client for any document control issues. Ensure that all project documentation is accurately logged, managed and issued via the Electronic Document Management System. It is imperative that each project has an accurate database containing each revision of all documents/drawings issued on a project and capturing all necessary meta\-data for each record including every document that is issued to each Company throughout the life of the project.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Document Controller with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Responsible for performing difficult and complex work assignments involving independent judgment to determine a course of action consistent with established functional and organization's policies and goals. Ability to lead and/or train lesser seasoned individuals.
* Performs difficult technical support assignments, requiring the application of advanced techniques, and engineering and mathematical principles, in accordance with established standards and procedures. May act as lead to lower\-level team members.
* Works under direct supervision with scope for planning and organization of work methods on assigned projects. Receives assignments in terms of specific objectives and priorities. Work is reviewed for accuracy, completeness and accomplishment of objectives. May receive supervised / self\-training in more advanced discipline work practices / applications.
* May exercise work direction over a small number of personnel, involving guidance and instruction on work methods and checking finished work.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Technical school graduate with 5\+ years relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Strong ability to inform and persuade on complex matters through preparation and delivery of proposals, presentations and reports, as well as collaboration with stakeholders and management.
* Advanced understanding of systems, processes and tools related to field. Able to assist others and troubleshoot issues. May be involved in the development of new systems, processes and tools.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

 is a leading provider of administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. As we’re a global company with 11,000\+ colleagues based in over 125 offices across 87 jurisdictions, we actively seek out people with the talent and potential to flourish at TMF Group, whatever their background, and offer job opportunities to the broadest spectrum of people. * Solid background in training facilitation and delivering learning sessions.

* Experience in the financial services industry, ideally in an organization similar to TMF Group.
* Interest or experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI) or using digital tools to enhance learning and training methods.

***Kindly write to us with your resume and portfolio at talentaffair@gmail.com***




  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a curious and visually aware Content Strategist who can turn client briefs into compelling narratives for physical spaces. You will research clients, develop wall concepts and content themes, write spatial content, and create mood\-boards to guide our designers. You will contribute both
 



 during client pitches and after projects have been awarded. This is not a conventional social\-media content role. It sits at the intersection of research, storytelling, copywriting and visual thinking.

  Research the client’s business, industry, audience, culture and brand philosophy.
 



  Participate in briefing meetings and identify the purpose of different spaces.
 



  Develop customised content strategies, themes and wall concepts.
 



  Build narratives that connect individual walls to the organisation’s larger story.

  Adapt content to suit the wall size, viewing distance, audience and purpose.
 



  Create mood\-boards defining the intended style, imagery, colours, typography and overall mood.
 



  Convert concepts into clear and persuasive client presentations.
 



  Present ideas and explain the thinking behind them to clients.
 



  Brief designers and review their work to ensure alignment with the approved concept.
 



  Coordinate with design, business development and project teams.
 



  Manage multiple assignments, feedback rounds and submission timelines.
 



  





**Skills Required** 




  Strong research, writing and storytelling ability.
 



  Excellent command of written and spoken English.
 



  Ability to write both concise copy and longer narrative content.
 



  Strong visual awareness and an eye for design references.
 



  Ability to create structured mood\-boards and presentation decks.
 



  Confidence in presenting ideas to clients.
 



  Curiosity about brands, people, culture, design and physical spaces.
 



  Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
 



  Ability to collaborate effectively with designers and accept feedback.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 



* Candidates may come from advertising, copywriting, brand strategy, communication design, journalism, literature, mass communication, architecture or related fields.

 Applicants should share relevant examples of brand concepts, copywriting, storytelling, research\-led content, mood\-boards or presentation decks. Previous spatial\-branding experience is welcome but not essential.

 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning.  Performs comprehensive quality analysis across region by evaluating performance metrics, trends, and compliance with quality standards. Translates data into actionable insights through structured reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to support continuous improvement, operational excellence, and informed decision\-making.
   

  

**The Role**

 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

+ Conduct detailed analysis of quality metrics, performance indicators, and trends across projects and regional/global level.

title: Medical Writer
description:
**Overview**
 Cactus Life Sciences is a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
   

  

 If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the Medical Writer role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data\-check) high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas \- learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* 1\-3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Should have experience working on publications.
* Experience working on gastric cancer publications would be preferable.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Excellent communication skills, especially with the clients.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process will include two
 **Technical Interviews** 
 with the Hiring Managers, and a
 **Technical Assessment,** 
 where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the
 **HR Interview.** 
 All interactions will be conducted virtually via
 **MS Teams.**
**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
 The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
   

  

 AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
   

  

 We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
   

  

 You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
   

  

**About CACTUS**
 At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

**Job Description**
**Mactores** 
 is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward\-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect, you own that documentation across all of our partnerships, not just AWS. You're given project and architecture details by the delivery team, and you turn them into the competency documentation each partner program requires, and into case studies you can explain and defend to a partner reviewer, to a prospect, to anyone asking "what did Mactores actually ship here."
   

  

 AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it holds up under questioning. Do this well, and the natural next step is a presales architect role, taking these case studies and this partner fluency directly into prospect conversations.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Create and maintain competency documentation across all of Mactores' partnerships AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
* Produce the technical validation write\-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation each partner's competency and service delivery program requires.
* Build a working command of Mactores' case studies well enough to explain them clearly the problem, the architecture, the outcome to partner reviewers, prospects, or internal stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review\-readiness of the final document.
* Keep documentation format and quality consistent across partners and engagements.
* Flag gaps in the project details you're given when they're not sufficient to produce audit\-ready documentation.
* Work against fixed deadlines tied to partner program renewal and review cycles.


**What we’re looking for?**
* 2–3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related role touching AWS and/or modern data/AI platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI).
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture concepts enough to read a design across different platforms and document it accurately.
* Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
* Comfortable explaining technical case studies out loud, not just writing them this role grows toward customer\-facing work.
* Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you haven't verified.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to \- Head of Publishing Operations** 




  





**About Packt** 




 Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e\-books, audiobooks, and video courses.
 



 For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high\-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality\-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.
 



 The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.
 



 The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.
 



 This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Technical:** 



* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code\-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code\-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles



  





**Editorial:** 



* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet



**Author/Expert management:** 



* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators



  





**Who You Are** 




 You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high\-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.
 



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders



  





**Good\-to\-have skills:** 



* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality\-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast\-paced environments



  





**Why Work at Packt** 




 We are a global and remote\-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:
 


* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge\-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work\-life balance.



 We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:
 


* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer\-to\-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self\-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.



  





**Benefits:** 




 You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.
 



 Bonus scheme
 



 5 day working week
 



 25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)
 



 Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India
 



 Training programs and Certification
 



 Group Medical Insurance
 



 Wellness initiatives
 



  





**Salary Range \- INR 25 \- 60K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)** 




  





**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third\-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**
